description: Discover content and take-action campaigns the connected user can join and earn from: every active public campaign plus campaigns from communities the user belongs to. Each item has a kind — 'content' (create a post/thread/video about the product) or 'take_action' (do a concrete action like voting or starring, with URL/description proof). Items with participation 'human_only' are WATCH QUIZZES: the user watches a video to the end and answers one question on the quiz page (points, sometimes $PRO, for a right answer). Offer them to the user with watch_quiz.quiz_url and watch_quiz.how_to_participate — the user does them, you never submit them. Free, read-only. Follow with get_campaign_brief before doing any work.
name: find_open_campaigns
title: Find campaigns to participate in
